build_tf_proto: build the TFDS protobuf files by downloading and compiling TensorFlow Example and Feature protos from GitHub
run_build_tf_proto: run the build_tf_proto script to recompile tf.train.Example and tf.train.Feature protos locally
create_tf_proto_download: create a function that downloads TensorFlow proto files from GitHub and adapts them for TFDS
test_tf_proto_cleaning: test the proto content cleaning functions that strip comments, rename packages, and fix imports
review_main_build_process: review the main build process that downloads protos, runs protoc, renames output files, and patches imports
